bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and large bags are prohibited; all other bags can be searched. No numeric bag limit is given.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Guests can use Caesars self-parking locations at the applicable parking rate.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Las Vegas FAQ does not designate a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The bowling venue serves food and drinks and does not allow outside food or beverages, including dessert. Purchases throughout the venue are cashless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Limited accessible seating is allocated first come, first served; ask venue staff on arrival.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The FAQ says guests can be searched each time they re-enter, but does not promise general re-entry for each concert.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens two hours before the listed door time on show days; check the ticket confirmation for pickup eligibility.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Concert pages list each event’s door time. Security may search people with a pat-down, wand or metal detector and search all bags; the venue recommends arriving early.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
